sources.title: Fauji Cement releases financial results for the first quarter of 2026
sources.excerpt: Pakistan: Fauji Cement has released its financial results for the first quarter of the 2026 financial year, which ended on 30 September 2026. The company reported a profit after tax of US$17.9m, compared to US$11.8m in the same period of 2025. It reported net revenues of US$94m during the period.
